import json, work
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())
rs=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())
report=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())
assert report == [work.evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]
base={'defaults':{'flag':True,'count':7,'name':'base'},'types':{'flag':'boolean','count':'integer','name':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
tests=[
 ({'layers':[{'flag':False,'count':0,'name':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'flag':False,'count':0,'name':''},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'count':2},{'count':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'flag':True,'count':7,'name':'base'},'error':None}),
 ({'layers':[{'missing':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
 ({'layers':[{'count':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
 ({'environment':{'flag':'false','count':'-12','name':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'flag':False,'count':-12,'name':''},'error':None}),
 ({'environment':{'count':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'count':'١'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
 ({'environment':{'missing':'1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})]
for req,want in tests:
 assert work.evaluate(req,base)==want,(req,work.evaluate(req,base),want)
assert work.evaluate({'environment':{'count':'2'}},dict(base,environment=False))=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}
assert work.evaluate({'layers':[{'name':None}]},dict(base,null_resets=False))=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}
print('comprehensive checks passed')
